plugin.name: World_Map_Window
plugin.author: ChatGPT
plugin.purpose: Displays the overworld map and exposes its literal 9x9 grid to the automapper
plugin.description:
WORLD MAP WINDOW v2.13
Uses persistent overworld visual memory. Previously-seen 9x9 views are reconstructed instantly from the Automapper database, while real MUD map probes are reserved for unknown cells, localization, and boundary confirmation.
The miniwindow: - uses the current room name as its title - sizes itself to fit the 9 x 9 map and title - preserves the original colours sent by the MUD - remains draggable - hides automatically in areas with no map - broadcasts authoritative OVERWORLD/MAPPABLE state to sibling plugins - keeps OVERWORLD presentation sticky until live evidence proves a local boundary - redraws memorized overworld cells immediately on every known movement - requests the real MUD map only when the current 9x9 contains unknown cells or needs authoritative localization - keeps speedwalk-safe debouncing only for genuinely necessary live probes - exposes the current literal 9 x 9 grid to the navigation mapper
COMMANDS:
mapwin show mapwin hide mapwin refresh (force a live MUD map capture and relearn this 9x9)
Modular theme client: colours are supplied by UI_Theme_Controller v2.0 when available.

muclient.script:
require "movewindow"
Win = GetPluginID()
-------------------------------------------------- -- MAP FORMAT --------------------------------------------------
MAP_ROWS = 9 MAP_COLUMNS = 9
-------------------------------------------------- -- TIMEOUTS --------------------------------------------------
MAP_HEADER_TIMEOUT = 3.0 MAP_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT = 3.0
-- Do not inject an automatic "map" command while room headers are still arriving. -- Native/client speedwalks can deliver many rooms in a tight burst; issuing probes -- from inside that burst leaves map commands queued behind movement and can produce -- visible "This area has no map." lines after the speedwalk has already finished. MAP_REQUEST_SETTLE_TIME = 0.35
-------------------------------------------------- -- COMPACT WINDOW LAYOUT --------------------------------------------------
TITLE_HEIGHT = 21
FONT_NAME = "Lucida Console"
MAP_FONT_SIZE = 12
TITLE_FONT_MAX_SIZE = 9 TITLE_FONT_MIN_SIZE = 4
MAP_LINE_HEIGHT = 15
SIDE_PADDING = 7 TOP_PADDING = 5 BOTTOM_PADDING = 6
TITLE_SIDE_PADDING = 6
-- Keep the map window a little wider than the raw 9-column map. -- 1.25 = 25% wider. WINDOW_WIDTH_MULTIPLIER = 1.25
WINDOW_WIDTH = tonumber(GetVariable("worldmap_width")) WINDOW_HEIGHT = tonumber(GetVariable("worldmap_height"))
MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH = 105 MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT = 105 RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE = 14 worldMapResizeActive = false
-- A hidden/placeholder miniwindow is not a trustworthy source of screen -- coordinates in MUSHclient. Keep the movewindow/restored position authoritative -- until the first real visible map render has created the final window. managedLayoutPositionPending = true worldMapSurfaceReady = false worldMapSurfaceWidth = 0 worldMapSurfaceHeight = 0
function SaveWorldMapWindowSize() if WINDOW_WIDTH and WINDOW_HEIGHT then SetVariable("worldmap_width", tostring(math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH))) SetVariable("worldmap_height", tostring(math.floor(WINDOW_HEIGHT))) end end
function FitMapFontForDimensions(width, height) if not width or not height then return end
local chosen = 5
for size = 18, 5, -1 do WindowFont(Win, "map"..Win, FONT_NAME, size, false) WindowFont(Win, "mapbold"..Win, FONT_NAME, size, true)
local cw = WindowTextWidth(Win, "map"..Win, "M") local lineH = size + 3 local needW = cw * MAP_COLUMNS + SIDE_PADDING * 2 + 4 local needH = TITLE_HEIGHT + TOP_PADDING + MAP_ROWS * lineH + BOTTOM_PADDING + 4
if needW <= width and needH <= height then chosen = size break end end
MAP_LINE_HEIGHT = chosen + 3 WindowFont(Win, "map"..Win, FONT_NAME, chosen, false) WindowFont(Win, "mapbold"..Win, FONT_NAME, chosen, true) end
function WorldMapResizeMouseDown(flags, hotspot_id) worldMapResizeActive = true return 0 end
function UpdateWorldMapResizeFromMouse() local mx = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 17)) local my = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 18)) local left = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 10)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 1)) or 0 local top = tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 11)) or tonumber(WindowInfo(Win, 2)) or 0
if not mx or not my then return false end
WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(mx - left + 1)) WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(my - top + 1))
WindowResize(Win, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, BACKGROUND_COLOUR) Redraw() return true end
function WorldMapResizeMouseMove(flags, hotspot_id) if worldMapResizeActive then UpdateWorldMapResizeFromMouse() end
SetCursor(miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow) return 0 end
function WorldMapResizeMouseUp(flags, hotspot_id) if worldMapResizeActive then UpdateWorldMapResizeFromMouse() end
worldMapResizeActive = false SaveWorldMapWindowSize() RenderMapWindow() pcall(SaveState) return 0 end
function InstallWorldMapResizeHandle() if not WINDOW_WIDTH or not WINDOW_HEIGHT then return end
WindowDeleteHotspot(Win, "00_resize")
WindowAddHotspot( Win, "00_resize", WINDOW_WIDTH - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE, WINDOW_HEIGHT - RESIZE_GRIP_SIZE, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, "", "", "WorldMapResizeMouseDown", "", "", "Drag to resize", miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow, 0 )
WindowDragHandler( Win, "00_resize", "WorldMapResizeMouseMove", "WorldMapResizeMouseUp", 0 )
WindowLine( Win, WINDOW_WIDTH - 11, WINDOW_HEIGHT - 3, WINDOW_WIDTH - 3, WINDOW_HEIGHT - 11, BORDER_COLOUR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
WindowLine( Win, WINDOW_WIDTH - 7, WINDOW_HEIGHT - 3, WINDOW_WIDTH - 3, WINDOW_HEIGHT - 7, BORDER_COLOUR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 ) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- SHARED UI THEMES -- -- IMPORTANT: -- These colours affect ONLY the miniwindow chrome. -- The captured 9 x 9 map cells continue to use the -- exact text/background colours sent by the MUD. --------------------------------------------------
THEME_CONTROLLER_ID = "43c8d047be7a418ba5e86916"
THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE = 9042
-------------------------------------------------- -- MODULAR THEME CLIENT -- -- The controller owns the real palette. The local THEMES table -- below is retained only as a safe fallback if the controller -- is unavailable. --------------------------------------------------
local THEME_PROFILE = "map"
function ThemeColour( role, fallback )
local rc, value = CallPlugin( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "GetThemeColour", THEME_PROFILE, role )
if rc == error_code.eOK and type( value ) == "string" and value ~= "" then
return ColourNameToRGB( value )
end
return ColourNameToRGB( fallback ) end
THEMES = {
classic = { background = "#000000", border = "#808080", title_bar = "darkslategray", title = "gold" },
amber = { background = "#050301", border = "#6B3D18", title_bar = "#160B03", title = "#FFB347" },
default = { background = "#000500", border = "#285B28", title_bar = "#061306", title = "#9AFF82" } }
function LoadTheme()
local theme = GetPluginVariable( THEME_CONTROLLER_ID, "theme" )
if not THEMES[theme] then theme = "default" end
local T = THEMES[theme]
BACKGROUND_COLOUR = ThemeColour("background", T.background)
BORDER_COLOUR = ThemeColour("border", T.border)
TITLE_BAR_COLOUR = ThemeColour("title_bar", T.title_bar)
TITLE_COLOUR = ThemeColour("title", T.title) end
LoadTheme()
-------------------------------------------------- -- STYLE FALLBACK --------------------------------------------------
MAP_FALLBACK_TEXT = ColourNameToRGB("#FFFFFF")
MAP_FALLBACK_BACKGROUND = ColourNameToRGB("#000000")
-------------------------------------------------- -- WINDOW STATE --------------------------------------------------
windowinfo = ""
windowManuallyHidden = false
-------------------------------------------------- -- LOCATION-CLASSIFICATION BROADCAST -- -- A successful 9x9 map capture means this room belongs to the -- overworld. The local schematic mapper excludes it from presentation, while -- v1.6+ still consumes the literal grid for hidden navigation. -- "This area has no map." means it is a normal local mappable room. --------------------------------------------------
WORLD_MAP_STATE_BROADCAST_MESSAGE = 9043 AUTOMAPPER_PLUGIN_ID = "a7c3e91b4d6f2085c1e73a9d" currentMapState = "UNKNOWN"
function BroadcastMapState(state, roomName) currentMapState = state or "UNKNOWN" BroadcastPlugin( WORLD_MAP_STATE_BROADCAST_MESSAGE, currentMapState .. "\t" .. tostring(roomName or currentRoomName or "") ) end
function GetWorldMapState() return currentMapState or "UNKNOWN" end
function GetWorldMapRoomName() return currentRoomName or "" end
function GetWorldMapExitList() return currentExitText or "" end
-- The automapper deliberately does not duplicate the world-map parser. -- It asks this plugin for the exact 9 x 9 text grid after an OVERWORLD -- state broadcast. Rows are separated with ASCII record separator (30) -- so literal spaces in the map are preserved unchanged. WORLD_MAP_GRID_ROW_SEP = string.char(30)
function GetWorldMapGrid() local rows = {} for i = 1, MAP_ROWS do local row = displayedMapLines[i] table.insert(rows, row and tostring(row.text or "") or "") end return table.concat(rows, WORLD_MAP_GRID_ROW_SEP) end
gridCaptureSerial = 0
function GetWorldMapGridSerial() return tostring(gridCaptureSerial or 0) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- STYLED GRID EXPORT + PERSISTENT MEMORY CLIENT --------------------------------------------------
WORLD_VISUAL_ROW_SEP = string.char(30) WORLD_VISUAL_CELL_SEP = string.char(29) WORLD_VISUAL_FIELD_SEP = string.char(31)
function SplitLiteral(value, separator) local result = {} value = tostring(value or "") separator = tostring(separator or "") if separator == "" then return {value} end local start = 1 while true do local pos = value:find(separator, start, true) if not pos then table.insert(result, value:sub(start)) break end table.insert(result, value:sub(start, pos - 1)) start = pos + #separator end return result end
function HexEncodeText(value) value = tostring(value or "") local out = {} for i = 1, #value do table.insert(out, string.format("%02X", value:byte(i))) end return table.concat(out) end
function HexDecodeText(value) value = tostring(value or "") if value == "" then return "" end if (#value % 2) ~= 0 or value:find("[^0-9A-Fa-f]") then return "" end local out = {} for i = 1, #value, 2 do table.insert(out, string.char(tonumber(value:sub(i, i + 1), 16) or 0)) end return table.concat(out) end
playerMarker = nil playerMarkerWorldKey = ""
function SavePlayerMarker() if not playerMarker then return end SetVariable("worldmap_player_glyph", HexEncodeText(playerMarker.char or "")) SetVariable("worldmap_player_fg", tostring(playerMarker.textcolour or MAP_FALLBACK_TEXT)) SetVariable("worldmap_player_bg", tostring(playerMarker.backcolour or MAP_FALLBACK_BACKGROUND)) SetVariable("worldmap_player_style", tostring(playerMarker.style or 0)) SetVariable("worldmap_player_world_key", tostring(playerMarkerWorldKey or "")) end
function LoadPlayerMarker() local glyph = HexDecodeText(GetVariable("worldmap_player_glyph") or "") if glyph == "" then return end playerMarker = { char = glyph, textcolour = tonumber(GetVariable("worldmap_player_fg")) or MAP_FALLBACK_TEXT, backcolour = tonumber(GetVariable("worldmap_player_bg")) or MAP_FALLBACK_BACKGROUND, style = tonumber(GetVariable("worldmap_player_style")) or 0 } playerMarkerWorldKey = tostring(GetVariable("worldmap_player_world_key") or "") end
function CapturePlayerMarkerFromDisplayedGrid() local row = displayedMapLines[5] if not row then return end local cells = BuildStyleCells(row) local cell = cells and cells[5] or nil if not cell then return end playerMarker = { char = cell.char or " ", textcolour = cell.textcolour or MAP_FALLBACK_TEXT, backcolour = cell.backcolour or MAP_FALLBACK_BACKGROUND, style = cell.style or 0 } SavePlayerMarker() end
function GetWorldMapStyledGrid() if #displayedMapLines ~= 9 then return "" end local encodedRows = {} for rowIndex = 1, 9 do local cells = BuildStyleCells(displayedMapLines[rowIndex]) local encodedCells = {} for colIndex = 1, 9 do local cell = cells[colIndex] encodedCells[colIndex] = table.concat({ HexEncodeText(cell.char or " "), tostring(tonumber(cell.textcolour) or MAP_FALLBACK_TEXT), tostring(tonumber(cell.backcolour) or MAP_FALLBACK_BACKGROUND), tostring(tonumber(cell.style) or 0) }, WORLD_VISUAL_FIELD_SEP) end encodedRows[rowIndex] = table.concat(encodedCells, WORLD_VISUAL_CELL_SEP) end return table.concat(encodedRows, WORLD_VISUAL_ROW_SEP) end
function AskAutomapperMemoryStyledGrid() if PluginSupports(AUTOMAPPER_PLUGIN_ID, "GetWorldMemoryStyledGrid") ~= error_code.eOK then return nil end local rc, value = CallPlugin(AUTOMAPPER_PLUGIN_ID, "GetWorldMemoryStyledGrid") if rc ~= error_code.eOK or type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" then return nil end return value end
function AskAutomapperAutoWalkActive() if PluginSupports(AUTOMAPPER_PLUGIN_ID, "IsAutoWalkActiveForWorldMap") ~= error_code.eOK then return false end local rc, value = CallPlugin(AUTOMAPPER_PLUGIN_ID, "IsAutoWalkActiveForWorldMap") return rc == error_code.eOK and tostring(value) == "1" end
function CurrentAutomapperWorldKey() if PluginSupports(AUTOMAPPER_PLUGIN_ID, "GetCurrentWorldCoordinateKey") ~= error_code.eOK then return "" end local rc, value = CallPlugin(AUTOMAPPER_PLUGIN_ID, "GetCurrentWorldCoordinateKey") if rc ~= error_code.eOK or type(value) ~= "string" then return "" end return value end
function TagPlayerMarkerToCurrentWorldCell() local key = CurrentAutomapperWorldKey() if key == "" then return end playerMarkerWorldKey = key SavePlayerMarker() end
function DecodeMemoryStyledGrid(value) local encodedRows = SplitLiteral(value, WORLD_VISUAL_ROW_SEP) if #encodedRows ~= 9 then return nil, 81 end local rows = {} local unknown = 0 local markerCurrent = playerMarker ~= nil and playerMarkerWorldKey ~= "" and playerMarkerWorldKey == CurrentAutomapperWorldKey()
for rowIndex = 1, 9 do local encodedCells = SplitLiteral(encodedRows[rowIndex], WORLD_VISUAL_CELL_SEP) if #encodedCells ~= 9 then return nil, 81 end local rowCells = {} local textParts = {} local styleRuns = {}
for colIndex = 1, 9 do local fields = SplitLiteral(encodedCells[colIndex], WORLD_VISUAL_FIELD_SEP) if #fields < 5 then return nil, 81 end local known = tostring(fields[5]) == "1" local glyph = known and HexDecodeText(fields[1]) or " " if glyph == "" then glyph = " " end local cell = { char = glyph, textcolour = tonumber(fields[2]) or MAP_FALLBACK_TEXT, backcolour = tonumber(fields[3]) or MAP_FALLBACK_BACKGROUND, style = tonumber(fields[4]) or 0, known = known } if not known and not (rowIndex == 5 and colIndex == 5 and markerCurrent) then unknown = unknown + 1 end rowCells[colIndex] = cell end
-- The live player marker is an overlay. Preserve the memorized terrain -- background when it exists, but never mistake a prior center marker for -- static terrain. The center may be treated as visually complete only -- when the saved marker is tagged to this exact world coordinate. if rowIndex == 5 and playerMarker then local center = rowCells[5] center.char = playerMarker.char or center.char center.textcolour = playerMarker.textcolour or center.textcolour center.style = playerMarker.style or center.style if not center.known then center.backcolour = playerMarker.backcolour or center.backcolour end end
for colIndex = 1, 9 do local cell = rowCells[colIndex] table.insert(textParts, cell.char) table.insert(styleRuns, { text = cell.char, length = #cell.char, textcolour = cell.textcolour, backcolour = cell.backcolour, style = cell.style }) end rows[rowIndex] = {text = table.concat(textParts), styles = styleRuns} end
return rows, unknown end
function TryRenderMemorizedWorldMap() local encoded = AskAutomapperMemoryStyledGrid() if not encoded then return false, false end local rows, unknown = DecodeMemoryStyledGrid(encoded) if not rows then return false, false end
displayedMapLines = rows displayedRoomName = currentRoomName or "WORLD MAP" if not windowManuallyHidden then RenderMapWindow() end return true, (unknown == 0) end
function RequestMissingWorldMemory() -- Normal manual movement should not pay the old 350-450ms debounce tax. -- Only an active multi-step Automapper walk retains the queue-safe delay. if AskAutomapperAutoWalkActive() then ScheduleMapRequest(false) else RequestMap(false) end end
function AskAutomapperClassification(roomName, exitText) if PluginSupports(AUTOMAPPER_PLUGIN_ID, "ClassifyRoomForWorldMap") ~= error_code.eOK then return "PROBE" end local rc, value = CallPlugin( AUTOMAPPER_PLUGIN_ID, "ClassifyRoomForWorldMap", tostring(roomName or ""), tostring(exitText or "") ) if rc ~= error_code.eOK or type(value) ~= "string" then return "PROBE" end value = value:upper() if value == "MAPPABLE" or value == "OVERWORLD" then return value end return "PROBE" end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ROOM STATE --------------------------------------------------
roomGeneration = 0
currentRoomName = "WORLD MAP" currentExitText = ""
requestGeneration = nil requestRoomName = nil requestExitText = nil
-- Rooms conclusively returning "This area has no map." can be classified -- immediately on later visits. This prevents rapid local movement from being -- serialized behind a fresh map probe every single time. localMappableCache = {}
function RoomClassificationKey(roomName, exitText) return tostring(roomName or ""):lower() .. "\t" .. tostring(exitText or ""):lower() end
function CacheLocalMappable(roomName, exitText) localMappableCache[RoomClassificationKey(roomName, exitText)] = true end
function IsCachedLocalMappable(roomName, exitText) return localMappableCache[RoomClassificationKey(roomName, exitText)] == true end
displayedRoomName = "WORLD MAP"
-------------------------------------------------- -- REQUEST STATE --------------------------------------------------
mode = "idle"
requestStartTime = 0
captureLastRowTime = 0
refreshNeeded = false
-- Active/queued map requests can be presentation-only. These refresh the -- literal 9x9 map after known overworld movement without re-running -- automapper localization or publishing a new authoritative grid serial. requestVisualOnly = false queuedVisualOnly = false
-- A room header requests classification/presentation, but the actual MUD "map" -- command is delayed until room headers have been quiet for a short interval. -- Each new room replaces the deferred request, so a 20-room speedwalk results in -- at most one probe/refresh for the final room. deferredMapPending = false deferredMapVisualOnly = false deferredMapGeneration = nil deferredMapNotBefore = 0
-------------------------------------------------- -- MAP DATA --------------------------------------------------
mapLines = {}
displayedMapLines = {}
-------------------------------------------------- -- COPY STYLE RUNS --------------------------------------------------
function CopyStyles(styles)
local copied = {}
if type(styles) ~= "table" then return copied end
for _, styleRun in ipairs(styles) do
table.insert( copied, { text = styleRun.text or "",
length = styleRun.length or #(styleRun.text or ""),
textcolour = styleRun.textcolour or MAP_FALLBACK_TEXT,
backcolour = styleRun.backcolour or MAP_FALLBACK_BACKGROUND,
style = styleRun.style or 0 } )
end
return copied
end
function CopyMapRow(row)
return { text = row.text,
styles = CopyStyles( row.styles ) }
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- TRIGGER CONTROL --------------------------------------------------
function EnableAutomaticResponseTriggers()
EnableTrigger( "WorldMap_MapHeader", true )
EnableTrigger( "WorldMap_NoMap", true )
EnableTrigger( "WorldMap_SuppressMapRows", true )
end
function DisableAutomaticResponseTriggers()
EnableTrigger( "WorldMap_MapHeader", false )
EnableTrigger( "WorldMap_NoMap", false )
EnableTrigger( "WorldMap_SuppressMapRows", false )
end
function EnableMapCapture()
EnableTrigger( "WorldMap_CaptureRow", true )
end
function DisableMapCapture()
EnableTrigger( "WorldMap_CaptureRow", false )
end
function DisableAllMapTriggers()
DisableMapCapture()
DisableAutomaticResponseTriggers()
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- REQUEST CANCELLATION / STATE RESET --------------------------------------------------
function CancelAutomaticMapRequest()
DisableAllMapTriggers() CancelDeferredMapRequest()
mapLines = {} requestGeneration = nil requestRoomName = nil requestExitText = nil requestStartTime = 0 captureLastRowTime = 0 refreshNeeded = false requestVisualOnly = false queuedVisualOnly = false CancelDeferredMapRequest() mode = "idle"
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- MAP AVAILABILITY RULES --------------------------------------------------
function IsMapBlockedRoom()
return currentRoomName == "The Center of Elsendor" end
-------------------------------------------------- -- DEFERRED / SPEEDWALK-SAFE MAP REQUESTS --------------------------------------------------
function CancelDeferredMapRequest() deferredMapPending = false deferredMapVisualOnly = false deferredMapGeneration = nil deferredMapNotBefore = 0 end
function ScheduleMapRequest(visualOnly) visualOnly = visualOnly == true
if IsMapBlockedRoom() then CancelDeferredMapRequest() return end
-- The newest room always owns the request. This is deliberately replacement, -- not a queue: during a speedwalk only the final room should ever be probed. deferredMapPending = true deferredMapVisualOnly = visualOnly deferredMapGeneration = roomGeneration deferredMapNotBefore = os.clock() + MAP_REQUEST_SETTLE_TIME end
function FlushDeferredMapRequest() if not deferredMapPending then return end
-- A newer room header superseded this request. if deferredMapGeneration ~= roomGeneration then CancelDeferredMapRequest() return end
if os.clock() < deferredMapNotBefore then return end if mode ~= "idle" then return end
local visualOnly = deferredMapVisualOnly CancelDeferredMapRequest() RequestMap(visualOnly) end
-------------------------------------------------- -- REQUEST MAP --------------------------------------------------
function RequestMap(visualOnly)
visualOnly = visualOnly == true
if IsMapBlockedRoom() then refreshNeeded = false queuedVisualOnly = false return end
if mode ~= "idle" then -- Classification is stronger than presentation. The first queued -- request records its own purpose; subsequent queued requests combine -- conservatively so any authoritative request keeps the queue authoritative. if not refreshNeeded then queuedVisualOnly = visualOnly else queuedVisualOnly = queuedVisualOnly and visualOnly end refreshNeeded = true return end
mapLines = {} requestGeneration = roomGeneration requestRoomName = currentRoomName requestExitText = currentExitText requestVisualOnly = visualOnly refreshNeeded = false queuedVisualOnly = false mode = "waitingForHeader" requestStartTime = os.clock() EnableAutomaticResponseTriggers() Send("map")
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ROOM HEADER --------------------------------------------------
function OnRoomHeader( name, line, wildcards, styles )
local previousState = currentMapState
-- Any not-yet-sent request belonged to the previous room. A speedwalk can -- replace this several times before the quiet-period timer ever fires. CancelDeferredMapRequest()
roomGeneration = roomGeneration + 1 currentRoomName = wildcards[1] or "WORLD MAP" currentExitText = wildcards[2] or "" currentMapState = "UNKNOWN"
-- The Center cannot be safely probed with map. It is the bootstrap local -- anchor; this remains the only explicit room exception. if IsMapBlockedRoom() then -- This room is definitively local. Kill any map request inherited -- from the room we just left so it cannot classify a later arrival. CancelAutomaticMapRequest() CacheLocalMappable(currentRoomName, currentExitText) displayedMapLines = {} WindowShow(Win, false) Redraw() BroadcastMapState("MAPPABLE", currentRoomName) return end
-- Ask the navigation mapper BEFORE consulting the local no-map cache. -- A room-name/exit fingerprint is not globally unique: an overworld location -- can legitimately resemble a local room. In older builds the cache could -- therefore flip presentation back to the schematic mapper while walking -- across the overworld. local learned = AskAutomapperClassification(currentRoomName, currentExitText)
if learned == "MAPPABLE" then -- Learned topology is authoritative here. Do not leave an older -- asynchronous map request alive behind this room transition. CancelAutomaticMapRequest() CacheLocalMappable(currentRoomName, currentExitText) displayedMapLines = {} WindowShow(Win, false) Redraw() BroadcastMapState("MAPPABLE", currentRoomName) return end
if learned == "OVERWORLD" then -- Commit the Automapper's already-known world transition immediately. -- BroadcastPlugin is synchronous, so when this returns the mapper's -- current world coordinates have advanced to this room. if mode ~= "idle" then CancelAutomaticMapRequest() end BroadcastMapState("OVERWORLD", currentRoomName)
-- First try the persistent cell memory. Previously-seen terrain appears -- immediately with no server command at all. If any of the 81 static -- cells are unknown, keep the best-effort memory frame visible and issue -- one authoritative map request to fill the missing cells. local rendered, complete = TryRenderMemorizedWorldMap() if complete then return end RequestMissingWorldMemory() return end
-- Reuse a cached no-map result only while we were already in a confirmed -- local area. Never let this cache pull us off an active overworld session, -- and never trust it after a reload/UNKNOWN state where context is missing. if previousState == "MAPPABLE" and IsCachedLocalMappable(currentRoomName, currentExitText) then CancelAutomaticMapRequest() displayedMapLines = {} WindowShow(Win, false) Redraw() BroadcastMapState("MAPPABLE", currentRoomName) return end
-- Unknown destination: probe exactly once. If an older request is still in -- flight, let it finish/timeout and then probe the newest room. While the -- previous state was OVERWORLD the old world-map frame remains visible until -- this authoritative probe resolves the boundary. -- Manual single-step movement probes immediately when live evidence is -- genuinely needed. Active Automapper walks still use the quiet-period -- scheduler so a burst collapses to the newest room. if AskAutomapperAutoWalkActive() then ScheduleMapRequest(false) else RequestMap(false) end end
-------------------------------------------------- -- BEGIN MAP CAPTURE --------------------------------------------------
function BeginMapCapture( name, line, wildcards, styles )
if mode ~= "waitingForHeader" then return end
mapLines = {}
mode = "collectingMap"
captureLastRowTime = os.clock()
EnableMapCapture()
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- CAPTURE MAP ROW --------------------------------------------------
function CaptureMapRow( name, line, wildcards, styles )
if mode ~= "collectingMap" then return end
if #line ~= MAP_COLUMNS then return end
local capturedRow = {
text = line,
styles = CopyStyles( styles ) }
if #capturedRow.styles == 0 then
capturedRow.styles = {
{ text = line,
length = #line,
textcolour = MAP_FALLBACK_TEXT,
backcolour = MAP_FALLBACK_BACKGROUND,
style = 0 }
}
end
table.insert( mapLines, capturedRow )
captureLastRowTime = os.clock()
if #mapLines >= MAP_ROWS then
FinishMapCapture()
end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- FINISH MAP CAPTURE --------------------------------------------------
function FinishMapCapture()
if mode ~= "collectingMap" then return end
DisableAllMapTriggers()
local stillCurrent = requestGeneration == roomGeneration
if stillCurrent then
displayedMapLines = {}
for _, row in ipairs(mapLines) do
table.insert( displayedMapLines, CopyMapRow(row) )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Use the name belonging to THIS map request. --------------------------------------------------
displayedRoomName = requestRoomName or currentRoomName or "WORLD MAP"
CapturePlayerMarkerFromDisplayedGrid()
if not requestVisualOnly then gridCaptureSerial = (gridCaptureSerial or 0) + 1
BroadcastMapState( "OVERWORLD", displayedRoomName ) TagPlayerMarkerToCurrentWorldCell() end
RenderMapWindow()
end
mapLines = {}
requestGeneration = nil requestRoomName = nil requestExitText = nil requestVisualOnly = false
mode = "idle"
if refreshNeeded then local visualOnly = queuedVisualOnly refreshNeeded = false queuedVisualOnly = false ScheduleMapRequest(visualOnly) end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- NO MAP --------------------------------------------------
function OnNoMap( name, line, wildcards, styles )
if mode ~= "waitingForHeader" then return end
DisableAllMapTriggers()
local stillCurrent = requestGeneration == roomGeneration
-- Only an authoritative probe may teach us that a room is local. A -- presentation-only refresh must never poison learned overworld state. if not requestVisualOnly and requestRoomName then CacheLocalMappable(requestRoomName, requestExitText or "") end
if stillCurrent and not requestVisualOnly then
displayedMapLines = {}
BroadcastMapState( "MAPPABLE", currentRoomName )
WindowShow( Win, false )
Redraw()
end
mapLines = {}
requestGeneration = nil requestRoomName = nil requestExitText = nil requestVisualOnly = false
mode = "idle"
if refreshNeeded then local visualOnly = queuedVisualOnly refreshNeeded = false queuedVisualOnly = false ScheduleMapRequest(visualOnly) end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ABORT --------------------------------------------------
function AbortAutomaticMap()
DisableAllMapTriggers()
mapLines = {}
requestGeneration = nil requestRoomName = nil requestExitText = nil requestVisualOnly = false
mode = "idle"
if refreshNeeded then local visualOnly = queuedVisualOnly refreshNeeded = false queuedVisualOnly = false ScheduleMapRequest(visualOnly) end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- TIMEOUT --------------------------------------------------
function PollMapTimeout()
-- Service speedwalk-debounced requests here. Timer cadence is 0.10 s, so -- a 0.35 s quiet period normally fires within roughly 0.35-0.45 s. FlushDeferredMapRequest()
if mode == "waitingForHeader" then
if os.clock() - requestStartTime >= MAP_HEADER_TIMEOUT then
AbortAutomaticMap()
end
elseif mode == "collectingMap" then
if os.clock() - captureLastRowTime >= MAP_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT then
AbortAutomaticMap()
end
end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- BUILD STYLE CELLS --------------------------------------------------
function BuildStyleCells(row)
local cells = {}
local column = 1
for _, styleRun in ipairs( row.styles or {} ) do
local runText = styleRun.text or ""
for i = 1, #runText do
if column > MAP_COLUMNS then break end
cells[column] = {
char = runText:sub( i, i ),
textcolour = styleRun.textcolour or MAP_FALLBACK_TEXT,
backcolour = styleRun.backcolour or MAP_FALLBACK_BACKGROUND,
style = styleRun.style or 0 }
column = column + 1
end
if column > MAP_COLUMNS then break end
end
while column <= MAP_COLUMNS do
local ch = row.text:sub( column, column )
if ch == "" then ch = " " end
cells[column] = {
char = ch,
textcolour = MAP_FALLBACK_TEXT,
backcolour = MAP_FALLBACK_BACKGROUND,
style = 0 }
column = column + 1
end
return cells
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- DRAW MAP ROW --------------------------------------------------
function DrawStyledMapRow( row, startX, y, charWidth )
local cells = BuildStyleCells(row)
for column = 1, MAP_COLUMNS do
local cell = cells[column]
local x = startX + ( (column - 1) * charWidth )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Original MUD background --------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, x, y, x + charWidth, y + MAP_LINE_HEIGHT, cell.backcolour )
local isBold = ( cell.style % 2 ) == 1
local fontId = isBold and "mapbold"..Win or "map"..Win
if cell.char ~= " " then
WindowText( Win, fontId, cell.char, x, y, x + charWidth + 2, y + MAP_LINE_HEIGHT, cell.textcolour, false )
end
end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- CALCULATE COMPACT WINDOW SIZE --------------------------------------------------
function GetCompactDimensions()
-- The user's chosen size is authoritative once the window has been resized. -- On first run, calculate the same compact natural size as before. if WINDOW_WIDTH and WINDOW_HEIGHT then FitMapFontForDimensions(WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT) else WindowFont(Win, "map"..Win, FONT_NAME, MAP_FONT_SIZE, false) WindowFont(Win, "mapbold"..Win, FONT_NAME, MAP_FONT_SIZE, true) MAP_LINE_HEIGHT = MAP_FONT_SIZE + 3 end
local charWidth = WindowTextWidth(Win, "map"..Win, "M") local mapPixelWidth = charWidth * MAP_COLUMNS
local naturalWidth = math.floor( (mapPixelWidth + SIDE_PADDING * 2) * WINDOW_WIDTH_MULTIPLIER )
local naturalHeight = TITLE_HEIGHT + TOP_PADDING + MAP_ROWS * MAP_LINE_HEIGHT + BOTTOM_PADDING
if not WINDOW_WIDTH then WINDOW_WIDTH = naturalWidth end if not WINDOW_HEIGHT then WINDOW_HEIGHT = naturalHeight end
WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(WINDOW_WIDTH)) WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(WINDOW_HEIGHT))
FitMapFontForDimensions(WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT)
charWidth = WindowTextWidth(Win, "map"..Win, "M") mapPixelWidth = charWidth * MAP_COLUMNS
return WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, charWidth, mapPixelWidth end
-------------------------------------------------- -- FIT TITLE FONT TO FIXED WINDOW WIDTH --------------------------------------------------
function FitTitleText( roomName, windowWidth )
roomName = roomName or "WORLD MAP"
local availableWidth = windowWidth - ( TITLE_SIDE_PADDING * 2 )
-------------------------------------------------- -- Keep the COMPLETE room name. -- -- Start at the normal title size and progressively -- shrink until the full title fits inside the fixed -- window width. --------------------------------------------------
for size = TITLE_FONT_MAX_SIZE, TITLE_FONT_MIN_SIZE, -1 do
WindowFont( Win, "title"..Win, FONT_NAME, size, true )
local width = WindowTextWidth( Win, "title"..Win, roomName )
if width <= availableWidth then
return roomName, width end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Very long edge case: -- -- Continue shrinking below the normal minimum rather -- than truncating the room name. This preserves the -- complete title at all times. --------------------------------------------------
for size = TITLE_FONT_MIN_SIZE - 1, 2, -1 do
WindowFont( Win, "title"..Win, FONT_NAME, size, true )
local width = WindowTextWidth( Win, "title"..Win, roomName )
if width <= availableWidth then
return roomName, width end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- Absolute fallback: -- use size 2 and draw the complete title. This should -- only occur for extraordinarily long room names. --------------------------------------------------
WindowFont( Win, "title"..Win, FONT_NAME, 2, true )
return roomName, WindowTextWidth( Win, "title"..Win, roomName )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- RENDER --------------------------------------------------
function SyncMapWindowPosition() if not windowinfo then return end
-- Never let the hidden 100x100 install placeholder overwrite a restored -- layout position. On some MUSHclient builds WindowInfo() reports 0,0 for -- that hidden placeholder even after WindowPosition()/movewindow state has -- been updated. The saved/restored windowinfo coordinates remain the -- authority until RenderMapWindow creates the first real map window. if managedLayoutPositionPending then return end
local left, top = WindowInfo(Win, 1), WindowInfo(Win, 2) if left ~= nil and top ~= nil then windowinfo.window_left = left windowinfo.window_top = top windowinfo.window_mode = WindowInfo(Win, 7) or windowinfo.window_mode windowinfo.window_flags = WindowInfo(Win, 8) or windowinfo.window_flags end end
function MapDragReleased() check(SaveState()) return false -- allow movewindow's normal repaint end
function RenderMapWindow()
if #displayedMapLines == 0 then return end
if windowManuallyHidden then return end
local windowWidth, windowHeight, charWidth, mapPixelWidth = GetCompactDimensions()
-------------------------------------------------- -- Keep the miniwindow surface alive between map updates. The 9x9 contents -- change every move, but recreating the actual window object every move is -- unnecessary. Create once; resize only when the user/layout changes size. --------------------------------------------------
SyncMapWindowPosition()
if not worldMapSurfaceReady then check( WindowCreate( Win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, windowWidth, windowHeight, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags, BACKGROUND_COLOUR ) ) worldMapSurfaceReady = true worldMapSurfaceWidth = windowWidth worldMapSurfaceHeight = windowHeight elseif worldMapSurfaceWidth ~= windowWidth or worldMapSurfaceHeight ~= windowHeight then check(WindowResize(Win, windowWidth, windowHeight, BACKGROUND_COLOUR)) worldMapSurfaceWidth = windowWidth worldMapSurfaceHeight = windowHeight end
-- The real map window now exists at the authoritative restored position, so -- subsequent renders may safely synchronize from WindowInfo(). if managedLayoutPositionPending then WindowPosition( Win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags ) managedLayoutPositionPending = false if movewindow then movewindow.save_state(Win) end end
-------------------------------------------------- -- BACKGROUND --------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, windowWidth, windowHeight, BACKGROUND_COLOUR )
-------------------------------------------------- -- TITLE BAR --------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, windowWidth, TITLE_HEIGHT, TITLE_BAR_COLOUR )
WindowLine( Win, 0, TITLE_HEIGHT - 1, windowWidth, TITLE_HEIGHT - 1, BORDER_COLOUR, miniwin.pen_solid, 1 )
-------------------------------------------------- -- ROOM NAME TITLE --------------------------------------------------
local titleText, titleWidth = FitTitleText( displayedRoomName, windowWidth )
local titleX = math.floor( ( windowWidth - titleWidth ) / 2 )
titleX = math.max( TITLE_SIDE_PADDING, titleX )
WindowText( Win, "title"..Win, titleText, titleX, 3, windowWidth - TITLE_SIDE_PADDING, TITLE_HEIGHT, TITLE_COLOUR, false )
-------------------------------------------------- -- CENTER MAP --------------------------------------------------
local mapLeft = math.floor( ( windowWidth - mapPixelWidth ) / 2 )
local y = TITLE_HEIGHT + TOP_PADDING
for _, row in ipairs( displayedMapLines ) do
DrawStyledMapRow( row, mapLeft, y, charWidth )
y = y + MAP_LINE_HEIGHT
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- BORDER --------------------------------------------------
WindowRectOp( Win, miniwin.rect_frame, 0, 0, windowWidth, windowHeight, BORDER_COLOUR )
-------------------------------------------------- -- DRAG TITLE BAR --------------------------------------------------
movewindow.add_drag_handler( Win, 0, 0, 0, TITLE_HEIGHT )
InstallWorldMapResizeHandle()
WindowShow( Win, true )
Redraw()
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- SHOW --------------------------------------------------
function mapwin_show( name, line, wildcards )
windowManuallyHidden = false
if #displayedMapLines > 0 then
RenderMapWindow()
end
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "World map window enabled." )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- FORCE LIVE REFRESH --------------------------------------------------
function mapwin_refresh(name, line, wildcards) CancelAutomaticMapRequest() RequestMap(false) ColourNote("yellow", "", "World map live refresh requested.") end
-------------------------------------------------- -- HIDE --------------------------------------------------
function mapwin_hide( name, line, wildcards )
windowManuallyHidden = true
WindowShow( Win, false )
Redraw()
ColourNote( "yellow", "", "World map window hidden." )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- INSTALL --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginInstall()
LoadTheme() LoadPlayerMarker()
DisableAllMapTriggers()
mode = "idle"
refreshNeeded = false requestVisualOnly = false queuedVisualOnly = false
requestGeneration = nil requestRoomName = nil
windowinfo = movewindow.install( Win, miniwin.pos_top_left, miniwin.create_absolute_location, true, nil, {dragrelease = MapDragReleased} )
-- movewindow has now restored the requested location. Do not replace it -- with coordinates read from the hidden placeholder before the real map is -- rendered for the first time. managedLayoutPositionPending = true
-------------------------------------------------- -- Create tiny placeholder first so fonts can be -- installed and measured. --------------------------------------------------
check( WindowCreate( Win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, 100, 100, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags, BACKGROUND_COLOUR ) )
worldMapSurfaceReady = false worldMapSurfaceWidth = 100 worldMapSurfaceHeight = 100
-------------------------------------------------- -- MAP FONT --------------------------------------------------
check( WindowFont( Win, "map"..Win, FONT_NAME, MAP_FONT_SIZE, false ) )
-------------------------------------------------- -- BOLD MAP FONT --------------------------------------------------
check( WindowFont( Win, "mapbold"..Win, FONT_NAME, MAP_FONT_SIZE, true ) )
-------------------------------------------------- -- SMALL TITLE FONT --------------------------------------------------
check( WindowFont( Win, "title"..Win, FONT_NAME, TITLE_FONT_MAX_SIZE, true ) )
movewindow.add_drag_handler( Win, 0, 0, 0, TITLE_HEIGHT )
WindowShow( Win, false )
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- SAVE STATE --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginSaveState()
SaveWorldMapWindowSize()
if not windowinfo then return end SyncMapWindowPosition() local prefix = "mw_" .. Win SetVariable(prefix .. "_windowx", windowinfo.window_left) SetVariable(prefix .. "_windowy", windowinfo.window_top) SetVariable(prefix .. "_windowmode", windowinfo.window_mode) SetVariable(prefix .. "_windowflags", windowinfo.window_flags)
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- ENABLE --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginEnable()
LoadTheme()
DisableAllMapTriggers()
mode = "idle"
refreshNeeded = false requestVisualOnly = false queuedVisualOnly = false
requestGeneration = nil requestRoomName = nil
if #displayedMapLines > 0 and not windowManuallyHidden then
RenderMapWindow()
end
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- DISABLE --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginDisable()
DisableAllMapTriggers()
mode = "idle"
refreshNeeded = false
WindowShow( Win, false )
Redraw()
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- THEME BROADCAST --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginBroadcast( msg, id, name, text )
if msg ~= THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE then return end
if id ~= THEME_CONTROLLER_ID then return end
LoadTheme()
-------------------------------------------------- -- Redraw only the window chrome. DrawStyledMapRow -- still uses the original captured MUD colours. --------------------------------------------------
if #displayedMapLines > 0 and not windowManuallyHidden and not IsMapBlockedRoom() then
RenderMapWindow() end end
-------------------------------------------------- -- CLOSE --------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginClose()
DisableAllMapTriggers()
WindowShow( Win, false )
Redraw()
end
-------------------------------------------------- -- PLUGIN CONTROLLER LAYOUT API --------------------------------------------------
function ManagedLayoutParse(spec) local windowName, sx, sy, sw, sh = tostring(spec or ""):match("^([^\t]+)\t(-?%d+)\t(-?%d+)\t(%d+)\t(%d+)$") if not windowName then return nil end return windowName, tonumber(sx), tonumber(sy), tonumber(sw), tonumber(sh) end
function ManagedLayoutSetMoveWindowInfo(info, winName, x, y) if type(info) ~= "table" then return end info.window_left = x info.window_top = y info.window_mode = tonumber(WindowInfo(winName, 7)) or info.window_mode or miniwin.pos_top_left info.window_flags = tonumber(WindowInfo(winName, 8)) or info.window_flags or miniwin.create_absolute_location end
function GetManagedLayoutWindows() return Win end
function ApplyManagedLayout(spec) local windowName, x, y, w, h = ManagedLayoutParse(spec) if windowName ~= Win then return "wrong window" end if type(windowinfo) ~= "table" then return "window not ready" end
WINDOW_WIDTH = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_WIDTH, math.floor(w)) WINDOW_HEIGHT = math.max(MIN_WINDOW_HEIGHT, math.floor(h)) SaveWorldMapWindowSize()
WindowResize( Win, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, BACKGROUND_COLOUR )
ManagedLayoutSetMoveWindowInfo(windowinfo, Win, x, y) managedLayoutPositionPending = true
if #displayedMapLines > 0 and not windowManuallyHidden then RenderMapWindow() else WindowResize(Win, WINDOW_WIDTH, WINDOW_HEIGHT, BACKGROUND_COLOUR) InstallWorldMapResizeHandle() end
WindowPosition( Win, x, y, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags )
if movewindow then movewindow.save_state(Win) end pcall(SaveState) Redraw() return "ok" end
